# Async component resolved under <Suspense> is mounted with the Suspense's namespace, so SVG children become HTML elements (issue #15639)

### Vue version

3.5.43 (also reproduces on the SFC Playground's latest `main` build)

### Link to minimal reproduction

https://play.vuejs.org/#

### Steps to reproduce

Open the reproduction. It renders the same component — whose root is a single `<path>` — inside an `<svg>` three times:

1. a sync component, under `<Suspense>`;
2. an async component (`defineAsyncComponent`), without `<Suspense>`;
3. the same async component, under `<Suspense>`.

The `<pre>` at the bottom prints each `<path>`'s `namespaceURI`.

### What is expected?

The line is drawn in all three `<svg>`s, and every `<path>` has the SVG namespace (`http://www.w3.org/2000/svg`).

### What is actually happening?

Case 3 draws nothing: its `<path>` is created as an HTML element (`http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml`) inside the `<svg>`.

```
1. sync + Suspense: http://www.w3.org/2000/svg
2. async, no Suspense: http://www.w3.org/2000/svg
3. async + Suspense: http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml
```

With `suspensible: false` on the async component, the path is an SVG element again.

### System Info

```shell
System: macOS 26.6.2 (Darwin 25.6)
Browsers: Chrome
npmPackages: vue 3.5.43
```

### Any additional comments?

Under a `<Suspense>`, a suspensible async component's setup is registered as a dependency of the boundary (`suspense.registerDep`). When it resolves, `registerDep` calls `setupRenderEffect(instance, vnode, parentNode(...), anchor, suspense, namespace, optimized)` where `namespace` is the one `createSuspenseBoundary` received — the namespace of the `<Suspense>` itself, not the one of the position the component was rendered at (`svg` here). The component's subtree is then mounted with the boundary's namespace.

We hit it with graph libraries (Vue Flow custom edge types) in an app that registers its components with `defineAsyncComponent` and renders pages under a `<Suspense>`: the edges' `<path>`s were in the DOM, with valid coordinates, but not drawn. Reproduced outside the browser as well (jsdom + `createApp`, Vue 3.5.43), with the same result.
